locked_reason: The evolution server interprets requests, reads governance rules, and decides whether generated changes may proceed.

exposes.GET /health: report model and API-key configuration state
exposes.GET /proposals: list proposal and failure audit records
exposes.POST /evolve: create, classify, store, and log an evolution proposal
exposes.POST /proposals/:request_id/validate: mechanically validate a pending proposal against safety and architecture gates
exposes.POST /proposals/:request_id/approve: record explicit human approval and install a validated protected registration transaction when requested
exposes.POST /proposals/:request_id/apply: revalidate and apply an approved proposal with rollback on failure

invariants: never treats generated output as trusted code
general proposal operations never write registry/ or a new module.json
new feature registration writes registry authority only after deterministic validation and explicit human approval
